intro.title: Summary
intro.description: Results-driven Software Engineer with a strong foundation in Data Engineering and Artificial Intellegence applications.

achievements: Migrated legacy SAS refund-risk processing logic to SQL, modernising data workflows and improving maintainability of production pipelines.
Built a Jinja-based SQL transpiler enabling shared processing logic to execute across Spark and SQLite for distributed training and local inference workloads.
Architected a Kedro pipeline integrating Azure ML and Azure Synapse to construct and refresh a LanceDB vector database for an internal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application.
Automated vector database refreshes with scheduled pipelines, eliminating manual operations and enabling reliable, repeatable data updates.
Engineered an open-source Machine Learning (ML) Feature Store for Gojek's driver-customer matchmaking model, enhancing data processing efficiency using Python, Java, Golang, Kafka, and Redis.
Resolved critical production issue by correcting Redis storage schema mismatch, ensuring uninterrupted matchmaking model performance.
Designed and deployed a comprehensive analytics dashboard using Grafana and GCP BigQuery, empowering management with real-time insights for data-driven decision-making.

projects.name: Broche: AI-Assisted Drawing App
achievements: Engineered an iPad AI-assisted drawing app that allows artists to co-create with AI image generation.
Developed a tool-calling Sketch Agent that automously calls AI rendering, editing features.
Optimised UI rendering with caching in hot path, reducing and drawing rendering time by 4.58×.

projects.name: B+Tree Database in C++
achievements: Built a disk-backed B+Tree database in C++ with columnar storage and filesystem block-aligned I/O.
Implemented bulk-loaded B+Tree indexing to support efficient range-based aggregation queries.
Achieved 7x faster queries and 87\% fewer data block reads using index scan vs. brute force scan.
